def reference(vectors):
    # rule sync_active_high_reset: synchronous reset state, sampled at posedge
    # rule bcd_counter_increment: BCD count advances on non-reset posedge
    # rule upper_digit_enables: combinational enables from current q
    q = 0
    out = []
    for v in vectors:
        if isinstance(v, dict):
            reset = v.get("reset", 0)
        elif isinstance(v, (list, tuple)):
            reset = v[0] if v else 0
        else:
            reset = v
        reset = int(reset) & 1

        if reset:
            # rule sync_active_high_reset
            q = 0
        else:
            # rule bcd_counter_increment
            d0 = q & 0xF
            d1 = (q >> 4) & 0xF
            d2 = (q >> 8) & 0xF
            d3 = (q >> 12) & 0xF

            d0 += 1
            if d0 == 10:
                d0 = 0
                d1 += 1
                if d1 == 10:
                    d1 = 0
                    d2 += 1
                    if d2 == 10:
                        d2 = 0
                        d3 += 1
                        if d3 == 10:
                            d3 = 0

            q = (d0 & 0xF) | ((d1 & 0xF) << 4) | ((d2 & 0xF) << 8) | ((d3 & 0xF) << 12)

        # rule upper_digit_enables
        ones = q & 0xF
        tens = (q >> 4) & 0xF
        hundreds = (q >> 8) & 0xF

        ena0 = 1 if ones == 9 else 0
        ena1 = 1 if (ones == 9 and tens == 9) else 0
        ena2 = 1 if (ones == 9 and tens == 9 and hundreds == 9) else 0
        ena = ena0 | (ena1 << 1) | (ena2 << 2)

        if reset:
            # rule sync_active_high_reset
            ena = 0

        out.append({"ena": ena & 0x7, "q": q & 0xFFFF})

    return out

def reference(vectors):
    # Rule sync_active_high_reset: synchronous active-high reset clears q and ena after the rising edge.
    # Rule bcd_counter_increment: on non-reset rising edges, increment four-digit BCD count modulo 10000.
    # Rule upper_digit_enables: combinational same-cycle carry enables based on current q, ena[0]=tens, ena[1]=hundreds, ena[2]=thousands.
    q = 0
    ena = 0
    current_reset = 0
    out = []
    for v in vectors:
        if 'reset' in v:
            r = v['reset']
        else:
            r = current_reset

        if r == 1:
            q = 0
            ena = 0
        else:
            d0 = q & 15
            d1 = (q >> 4) & 15
            d2 = (q >> 8) & 15
            d3 = (q >> 12) & 15
            n = d0 + 10 * d1 + 100 * d2 + 1000 * d3
            n = (n + 1) % 10000

            d0 = n % 10
            n //= 10
            d1 = n % 10
            n //= 10
            d2 = n % 10
            n //= 10
            d3 = n % 10
            q = d0 | (d1 << 4) | (d2 << 8) | (d3 << 12)

            ones = q & 15
            tens = (q >> 4) & 15
            hundreds = (q >> 8) & 15
            ena = 0
            if ones == 9:
                ena = ena | 1
                if tens == 9:
                    ena = ena | 2
                    if hundreds == 9:
                        ena = ena | 4

        out.append({'q': q, 'ena': ena})

        if 'mid' in v:
            mid = v['mid']
            if 'reset' in mid:
                current_reset = mid['reset']
            else:
                current_reset = r
        else:
            current_reset = r

    return out
